question: The business requirements for a forest product processing management system are described as follows: This system is mainly used for managing the production operations of forest product processing factories. For workshop management, the system needs to record each workshop's ID, name and address information. Each workshop is equipped with multiple workers, whose information includes worker ID, name and contact number. In their daily work, workers need to record detailed processing information, including raw materials used, processing time, specific product name, production quantity and product quality rating. The system also needs to manage the inventory of raw materials for each workshop, recording the name and real-time inventory quantity of various raw materials. For production quality management, the system will automatically calculate production performance metrics for each workshop based on workers' processing records, including monthly total processing volume, product qualification rate and other assessment indicators. Managers can use this data to understand production status in real time and make adjustments to production planning and quality control.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0017

CREATE TABLE workshops (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  address VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE workers (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  contact_number VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  workshop_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (workshop_id) REFERENCES workshops(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE processing_records (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  worker_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  raw_materials VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  processing_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  product_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  production_quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  product_quality_rating INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES workers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE raw_materials (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  workshop_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  inventory_quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (workshop_id) REFERENCES workshops(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE production_metrics (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  workshop_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  monthly_total_processing_volume INT(11) NOT NULL,
  product_qualification_rate INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (workshop_id) REFERENCES workshops(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
